description: MOVE of an alphanumeric figurative constant (QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, non-digit ALL literal) to a numeric or numeric-edited item - permitted through 2014 (implemented on the StoreAsImage substrate), REMOVED by ISO 2023 (Annex E.2 item 1 bullet 1; 14.9.25.3 SR5) except the digit-only-ALL-to-integer case; QUOTE rides its own dual row move-quote-numeric-obsolete-2014 (obsolete 2014 first, Annex E.2 item 21 - the adversarial-review correction). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): 1985 puts these constants in category alphanumeric, 'All other figurative constants belong to the category alphanumeric.' (§1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3), refuses only SPACE of them as a numeric receiver's sender, 'The figurative constant SPACE, an alphanumeric edited data item, or an alphabetic data item must not be moved to a numeric or numeric edited data item.' (§1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3a), and 'All other elementary moves are legal' (§1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3e); 2002 and 2014 again name SPACE alone, 'The figurative constant SPACE shall not be moved to a numeric or numeric-edited item.' (§2002:14.8.24.2 SR5, §2014:14.9.24.2 SR5); 2023 prohibits the rest, 'In all other cases, the move of an alphanumeric figurative constant (SPACE, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, ALL "literal", or ALL symbolic-character) to either a numeric item or a numeric-edited item is prohibited.' (§2023:14.9.25.3 SR5), and lists the removal in §2023:E.2 item 1: 'Move of alphanumeric figurative constants to numeric or numeric-edited items'. Documented residues (DEVLOG 595): pre-removal image semantics cover elementary numeric-DISPLAY receivers - a Tier-A REDEFINES-class or BINARY/PACKED/COMP-5/float receiver stays a NARROW runtime-loud guard (legal-per-ISO-2014 shapes, no corpus hits); a MULTI-CHARACTER ALL literal is not this row's - it is 8.3.3.6.3 SR3's, row all-literal-multichar-numeric-removed-2002 (kb/Work PB422, VCR 7.13). SPACE is NOT this row's (kb/Work PB3605): its move to a numeric or numeric-edited item is refused at every edition, by §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3a, §2002:14.8.24.2 SR5 and §2014:14.9.24.2 SR5 (quoted above) and by §2023:14.9.25.3 SR5 (VCR row 7.41), so MOVE SPACE to a numeric or numeric-edited item is refused at every edition by the binder's MOVE chain (MoveValidity.FigurativeRefusal, COBOL0819). Gate: VersionConformancePass.GateSr5 (W2 track A, DEVLOG 593; PB879). ASKED BY EVERY ASKER OF THE MOVE RULES (kb/Work PB3755), through the one body FigurativeAssociation.GateSr5: the written MOVE and every implicit FROM/INTO move (VersionConformancePass.GateMove), INITIALIZE REPLACING's hypothetical MOVE (VersionConformancePass.GateInitialize, 14.9.20.3 SR4) and a figurative argument BY CONTENT into a numeric-edited formal parameter of a CALL, an INVOKE or a user-defined function (ParameterConformance.GateFigurativeEdition; 14.8.2.3.3 rule 2 d: the formal is not numeric, so the MOVE rules apply, not rule 2 a's COMPUTE).
